LanguageData.PhobosAutoDrive_NotOnMap: It can only drive itself about on a map.
LanguageData.PhobosAutoDrive_CannotMove: {VEHICLE} cannot move: its engine or running gear is too badly damaged.
LanguageData.PhobosAutoDrive_NoDriver: {VEHICLE} needs someone aboard to drive it.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_GizmoDesc: With someone aboard to drive, {VEHICLE} goes about the map by itself, stops beside loose {WHAT}, and lifts them aboard with its grab from up to {CELLS} cells away. {WHENFULL}\n\nIt never takes from stockpiles or shelves, nor anything forbidden or that a colonist is about to carry: forbid anything you want left where it is. It stops if enemies come, or if you give it any other order. Change what it gathers, and where it unloads, with Gather what.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_WhenFullStop: It goes on until its cargo is full or nothing it can reach is left, and stops where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_WhenFullUnload: Each time its cargo is full it backs up to {PLACE}, tips what it gathered and goes back out, until nothing it can reach is left; then it tips the last of it.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_FilterGizmoDesc: Choose what {VEHICLE} gathers, as you would for a stockpile, and where it may go for it.\n\nNow: {WHAT}, {AREA}. Unloads at: {UNLOAD}.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_UnloadAtDesc: When its cargo is full, {VEHICLE} backs up to this place, tail first, and tips what it gathered: into a bulk bunker from its open end, onto a stockpile from any side. Only places that take something it gathers are listed. Anything else aboard, such as spare parts, stays aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_NoWorker: {VEHICLE} needs a loading grab to gather.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_NothingChosen: Nothing is chosen to gather. Choose something with Gather what.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EnemiesChoiceDesc: Whether {VEHICLE} stops gathering when enemies come. With its armoured cab it can keep working through a fight, but whoever drives it is still in the fight, and so is the truck.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EnemiesStopSet: {VEHICLE} will stop gathering when enemies come.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EnemiesKeepWorkingSet: {VEHICLE} will keep gathering while enemies are about.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_Done: {VEHICLE} has finished gathering: {COUNT} loads, {MASS} kg, from {PLACES} places.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_DoneNothing: {VEHICLE} has stopped gathering, with nothing gathered.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EndNothingLeft: Nothing more of what you chose lies anywhere it can reach.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EndNoWay: It could not find a way to what is left.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EndThreat: Enemies are about. It has stopped where it is, with its engine running.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_EndNoWayToUnload: It could not find a way to back up to its unloading place.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_DoneUnloaded: It tipped {COUNT} things at {PLACE} on {TRIPS} trips.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_LineSeeking: Gathering: choosing what to fetch next.
LanguageData.PhobosGather_LineWorking: Gathering: lifting with the grab. {COUNT} loads, {MASS} kg so far.
